title: DAX Style Rules
description: Machine-readable DAX best practices derived from the DAX Style Guide.

rules.description: Use VAR and RETURN for non-trivial measures (operators, CALCULATE, iterators).
Prefer DIVIDE() over / to handle divide-by-zero and BLANK semantics.
Do not use FORMAT() in computational measures (format with formatString).
Prefer REMOVEFILTERS over ALL when only filter removal is intended.
Avoid deep IF() nesting; use SWITCH(TRUE()).
Use BLANK() as no-data; prefer DIVIDE alternate result or COALESCE for display-only.
Use DATEADD/SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR/DATESYTD for standard time intelligence.
Totals/hierarchies: consider ISINSCOPE() patterns to stabilize totals.
Use CALCULATE/CALCULATETABLE for context modifications instead of wrapping FILTER chains where a direct predicate fits.
Use iterators (SUMX/AVERAGEX/MINX/MAXX) only when a row context is required.
